title: Untested extrapolation of sinusoidal positional encodings
description: The sinusoidal positional encoding is chosen because it may allow extrapolation to sequence lengths longer than those seen during training, but this capability is hypothesized and not empirically tested in the paper.
canonical_description: extrapolation of sinusoidal positional encodings to unseen sequence lengths is hypothesized but untested
